You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it. This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what finance needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the finance data in the lakehouse and building the dashboards the CFO and the finance team rely on. You will also improve the processes and systems that create the numbers in the first place, automate the manual work that eats the month, and make our finance data understandable to everyone who needs it, including our AI assistants. At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). We are a fast-growing international group operating across several European entities, and the standards we hold our financial data to are rising just as quickly. Join us in building a finance reporting foundation that is accurate, traceable, and ready for any question asked of it. jobs.title: Tech Lead / CTO (m/w/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Tax advisory has everything automation needs: structured data, recurring work, clear rules. Yet the profession never made the leap, because recurring does not mean uniform. Every case has its own twist, and the law keeps moving. Reasoning resolves exactly this variance. That is why the window is open now. The model is no longer the scarce part. Expert knowledge and real case data are, and AI labs pay a premium for exactly this. Vogel holds what no AI-native player has: decades of accounting data, edge cases and judgment calls from several thousand mid-sized companies, audited and closed. It never leaves the house, and it becomes the edge of what you build. The market is being reordered: four in ten tax advisors in Germany leave the profession within ten years, and many of their firms will find no successor. Vogel acquires established advisory firms and develops them further, and every acquisition adds to that base. We have already produced our own annual financial statements with AI. Today, that is one person with a tool. Turning it into a capability of the whole company is the job. You own the technology that makes Vogel AI-first: the data layer above DATEV, the agent infrastructure on top, and the control layer without which nothing in this profession may go live. You decide the architecture and the stack of what we build. What it does and in which order is decided together with Operations and Moritz Vogel in the role of chief product officer, close to the advisors who use it; you shape it with them. You report to and work directly with Moritz Vogel. What you'll do Architecture above DATEV Build the data layer above DATEV. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind. We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, with 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you'll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver. If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you. Your impact As Implementation Manager, you'll own the post-sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, guiding merchants from handover through testing to go live. You'll run kickoffs with internal and external stakeholders, set go live dates, keep progress on track, and coordinate testing and feedback along the way. You'll work closely with colleagues across sales, product and engineering, as well as with merchants directly, keeping everyone aligned as deals move toward launch. This function is newly formed, so you'll have real influence over how the role and its processes take shape, bringing in your own experience rather than following a fixed playbook. The role is also more technical than it might first appear: you'll get close to the real world edge cases and issues that surface once a solution meets implementation reality, giving you hands on technical exposure without needing a payments or engineering background going in. Your work protects revenue by keeping live dates on track, and it supports how Mollie scales delivery more broadly, building a structured, dedicated integration phase

jobs.title: Junior Market Analyst
jobs.description: MEYA HOLDINGS LTD is an international company specializing in digital assets, cryptocurrency markets, and financial research. We focus on developing data-driven trading approaches and optimizing market operations. Our remote team brings together professionals from different parts of the world. We are looking for a motivated Junior Market Analyst with at least 1 year of experience in cryptocurrency or financial trading. You will assist with market analysis, monitor trading performance, and contribute to improving our daily operational processes. Key Responsibilities Monitor cryptocurrency prices, trading volumes, and market developments. Analyze market data and identify potential trading opportunities. Assist with daily Spot, Futures, and Options trading activities. Monitor asset allocation across centralized and decentralized exchanges. Prepare reports on market conditions and trading performance. Identify operational or technical issues and coordinate with the relevant teams. Monitor automated trading systems and ensure compliance with risk management rules. Maintain accurate financial and operational records. Collaborate with internal departments to improve trading processes. What We Offer Fully remote position with no geographical restrictions. Flexible working hours across different time zones. Access to professional trading platforms and analytical tools. Opportunity to gain practical experience in digital asset markets. Career development opportunities within an international company. Friendly working environment with ongoing support and feedback. Requirements Basic understanding of spot, futures, and options markets. Analytical mindset and attention to detail. Ability to work under pressure and make quick decisions. Good communication skills in English (written and spoken). Team player, adaptable, and self-organized. Apply here: https://meyaxu.com/work/remoteok Please mention the word **PEACE** and tag RMy40MS4yMTAuMTIx when applying to show you read the job

jobs.title: Rekrutmen Private Banking Relationship Manager Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI)
jobs.description: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) adalah bank di Indonesia yang bergerak di bidang perbankan syariah. BSI merupakan bank hasil merger antara PT Bank BRI syariah Tbk, PT Bank Syariah Mandiri dan PT Bank BNI Syariah. Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) secara resmi mengeluarkan izin merger tiga usaha bank syariah tersebut pada 27 Januari 2021 melalui surat Nomor SR-3/PB.1/2021. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. Komposisi pemegang saham BSI adalah: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk 50,83%, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 24,85%, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 17,25%. Sisanya adalah pemegang saham yang masing-masing di bawah 5%. Penggabungan ini menyatukan kelebihan dari ketiga bank syariah tersebut, sehingga menghadirkan layanan yang lebih lengkap, jangkauan lebih luas, serta memiliki kapasitas permodalan yang lebih baik. Didukung sinergi dengan perusahaan serta komitmen pemerintah melalui Kementerian BUMN, BSI didorong untuk dapat bersaing di tingkat global. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) membuka kesempatan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Private Banking Relationship Manager Key Responsibilities: Build and manage long-term relationships with High Net Worth Individuals (HNWIs) and affluent clients Provide tailored wealth management, investment, and financial planning solutions aligned with clients financial goals Grow Assets Under Management (AUM) through portfolio development, client acquisition, and relationship expansion Deliver holistic advisory services across investment, protection, and wealth preservation solutions Identify new business opportunities through networking, referrals, and market engagement Maintain the highest standards of client service, professionalism, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance Requirements: Bachelor s Degree (S1) from any discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in Banking, Wealth Management, Priority Banking

jobs.title: Accounting Operations
jobs.description: We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. Weâre dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaidâs network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam. Role Overview You will be a key contributor to Accounting Operations and own the accounting for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity, and cost allocations. This includes preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciling accounts, analyzing balances and trends, and ensuring these areas are complete and accurate each month, quarter, and year-end. You will be the point of contact for your areas during the close and the annual audit. Over time, your responsibilities may expand into other areas of the close as the business and team grow. You will also help build scalable, efficient processes that support Plaidâs growth and public readiness. This includes documenting and strengthening controls in your areas, shortening the close, improving the quality and consistency of supporting documentation, and identifying opportunities to automate manual work. You will partner with the broader Accounting team, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and external auditors along the way. Responsibilities Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity and cost allocations, including journal entries
